provenance.name_aliases: The existing README identifies this sample-derived KTK preset as Piano; the Japanese programName is ピアノ.
provenance.gm_program_changes: MIDI Association General MIDI Level 1 names patch 1 Acoustic Grand Piano. MIDI Program Change data values are 0–127, so value 0 selects GM patch 1. Sources: https://midi.org/general-midi-level-1 and https://midi.org/expanded-midi-1-0-messages-list.
provenance.gm_percussion_program_changes: No percussion-channel mapping is established by the available KTK samples or the cited GM instrument patch list.

provenance.name_aliases: Pianica and keyboard harmonica are names used for this locally verified KTK preset in the existing README; programName is 鍵盤ハーモニカ.
provenance.gm_program_changes: No General MIDI patch is treated as equivalent to the KTK keyboard-harmonica preset.
provenance.gm_percussion_program_changes: This is a melodic KTK preset; no percussion-channel mapping is declared.

provenance.name_aliases: The existing README identifies this sample-derived KTK preset as Clarinet; programName is クラリネット, matching GM Level 1 patch 72.
provenance.gm_program_changes: MIDI Association General MIDI Level 1 names patch 72 Clarinet. MIDI Program Change data values are 0–127, so value 71 selects GM patch 72. Sources: https://midi.org/general-midi-level-1 and https://midi.org/expanded-midi-1-0-messages-list.
provenance.gm_percussion_program_changes: No percussion-channel mapping is established by the available KTK samples or the cited GM instrument patch list.

provenance.name_aliases: Drum Kit 1 is the English name for this sample-observed preset in the existing README; programName is ドラムキット１.
provenance.gm_program_changes: No melodic GM Program Change mapping is declared for this KTK percussion preset.
